title: Things
description: Follow the doorbells and sensors and other devices around you.
summary: Some devices have no radio of their own. A controller speaks for them and airs their readings under an X4 callsign. Things works out what each device is from what it reports. A doorbell gets a doorbell screen and a meter gets a meter screen. Nothing is fetched from a device until you connect to it on the local network yourself. A doorbell camera then offers a picture and a live view. It can also tell you when somebody rings.
